exam_title: IBPS SO IT Mains — Cloud Computing Subject Drill
subject: Cloud Computing
question: Which cloud service model gives the customer a finished application and hides the servers?
option_c: A bare-metal cage in which the customer brings every switch and no software is offered
explanation: Picture renting a finished app, a platform to run your own app, or only a machine: SaaS delivers a finished application, and the provider runs the stack beneath it. IaaS provides virtual machines and leaves the operating system and application to the customer. Remember: if you only use the application, it is SaaS.
hint: Picture renting a finished app, a platform to run your own app, or only a machine. The customer uses the application. Someone else runs the stack under it.
hint_2: Check the ideas that do not fit. IaaS hands over virtual machines. A bare-metal cage is not an application service. A packet filter is a network control.
hint_3: The line to carry into the exam is this: if you only use the application, it is SaaS.

exam_title: IBPS SO IT Mains — Cloud Computing Subject Drill
subject: Cloud Computing
question: Which statement about a public cloud is correct?
option_a: It is the same thing as a private VLAN inside one branch
option_b: It is owned and used by only one organisation and is never reached over a network
option_d: Infrastructure is offered to many customers over the internet by a provider
explanation: Picture a provider serving many customers from the same service, over the internet: A public cloud is a multi-tenant service operated by a provider and reached over the internet. A private cloud is dedicated to one organisation. Remember: many customers and a provider operator means a public cloud.
hint: Picture a provider serving many customers from the same service, over the internet. Public here means a provider serves many customers, not that the data is published to the world.
hint_2: Check the ideas that do not fit. Single-organisation ownership is the private-cloud idea. Virtual machines are normal in a public cloud. A branch VLAN is not a cloud deployment model.
hint_3: The line to carry into the exam is this: many customers and a provider operator means a public cloud.

subject: Cloud Computing
question: In the shared-responsibility model for IaaS, which task stays with the customer?
option_a: Physical security of the provider's data centre
option_b: Power and cooling of the hypervisor host
option_c: Patching and access control of the guest operating system
explanation: Picture renting a finished app, a platform to run your own app, or only a machine: On IaaS the provider secures the physical host and hypervisor, while the customer secures the guest operating system, the applications, and the data. Moving up to SaaS shifts more of that work to the provider. Remember: you rent the machine, and you still patch the guest.
hint: Picture renting a finished app, a platform to run your own app, or only a machine. The provider owns the building and the hypervisor. The guest is the customer's machine.
hint_2: Check the ideas that do not fit. Physical security, power, and CPU manufacture are provider or vendor duties. They do not move to the customer on IaaS.
hint_3: The line to carry into the exam is this: you rent the machine, and you still patch the guest.

exam_title: IBPS SO IT Mains — Cloud Computing Subject Drill
subject: Cloud Computing
question: Which purchase option uses spare provider capacity, costs less, and can be interrupted, so it suits fault-tolerant batch work?
option_a: A reserved instance with a term commitment and no reclaim
option_b: On-demand capacity that is not reclaimed in this way
option_c: A dedicated host that is never interrupted by the provider
explanation: Picture buying spare capacity cheaply, with the risk that the provider may take it back: Spot capacity uses spare provider capacity at a lower price and can be reclaimed, so the job must tolerate interruption. On-demand and reserved capacity are not reclaimed in that way. Remember: cheap and interruptible means spot.
hint: Picture buying spare capacity cheaply, with the risk that the provider may take it back. The price is low because the provider may take the capacity back.
hint_2: Check the ideas that do not fit. Reserved and on-demand capacity are not reclaimed as spare capacity. A dedicated host is the opposite of a reclaimable spare.
hint_3: The line to carry into the exam is this: cheap and interruptible means spot.

exam_title: IBPS SO IT Mains — Cloud Computing Subject Drill
subject: Cloud Computing
question: A container differs from a virtual machine mainly because a container does which of the following?
option_a: Shares the host kernel and packages the application with its user-space dependencies
option_b: Includes a guest kernel in every instance
option_d: Replaces the need for any host operating system
explanation: Picture a light parcel that shares the host engine, versus a whole extra computer: A container is an isolated process group on a shared kernel, which is why it is smaller and faster to start than a virtual machine. A virtual machine virtualises hardware and boots a guest kernel. Remember: a shared kernel means a container, and a guest kernel means a virtual machine.
hint: Picture a light parcel that shares the host engine, versus a whole extra computer. One of these isolates a process group. The other boots a guest kernel.
hint_2: Check the ideas that do not fit. A guest kernel is the virtual-machine picture. Containers start quickly, and they still need a host kernel.
hint_3: The line to carry into the exam is this: a shared kernel means a container, and a guest kernel means a virtual machine.

subject: Cloud Computing
question: During a network partition, a system that prefers availability over linearizable consistency will typically do which of the following?
option_a: Refuse every request on both sides until the partition heals, which would be the availability choice
option_b: Serve requests on both sides and reconcile later, accepting a temporary inconsistency
option_c: Guarantee linearizability and availability on both sides of every partition
option_d: Become unable to answer only because it chose consistency, while still claiming to be the availability choice
explanation: When the network is cut, a system cannot both answer everyone and keep one single order of updates. The availability choice answers on both sides and repairs the disagreement later. Remember: during a cut, the availability choice answers now and repairs later.
hint: Refusing every request until the cut heals is the consistency choice.
hint_2: Both guarantees at once are what this rule says you cannot have.
hint_3: Answer now on both sides, and reconcile afterwards.

exam_title: IBPS SO IT Mains — Cloud Computing Subject Drill
subject: Cloud Computing
question: Horizontal scaling means which of the following?
option_a: Replacing one server with a larger CPU in the same box
option_b: Adding RAM to the same virtual machine only
option_c: Adding more machines or instances to share the load
option_d: Compressing the database without adding capacity
explanation: Picture adding more counters, rather than making one counter bigger: Horizontal scaling adds nodes, while vertical scaling makes one node bigger. A cloud autoscaling group is a horizontal mechanism. Remember: more boxes is horizontal, and a bigger box is vertical.
hint: Picture adding more counters, rather than making one counter bigger. One direction adds nodes. The other makes a single node bigger.
hint_2: Check the ideas that do not fit. A larger CPU or more RAM in the same machine is vertical scaling. Compression is not scaling.
hint_3: The line to carry into the exam is this: more boxes is horizontal, and a bigger box is vertical.

question: Object storage, as opposed to a block volume, is accessed mainly as which of the following?
option_a: Objects addressed by a key, usually over an HTTP API
option_b: Raw disk blocks that only a local filesystem driver can see, with no object key
option_d: A tape robot with no API
explanation: Picture a browser asking a bank site for a page, or being told the page has moved: Object storage stores blobs under a key and is reached by a web API, which suits images, backups, and data lakes. A block volume looks like a disk to a virtual machine. Remember: a key plus HTTP means object storage.
hint: Picture a browser asking a bank site for a page, or being told the page has moved. You store a blob under a name and fetch it with a web call.
hint_2: Check the ideas that do not fit. Raw blocks are the block-volume picture. Registers and a tape robot with no API are not object storage.
hint_3: The line to carry into the exam is this: a key plus HTTP means object storage.
